what: First-wave rename maps that contain a name the controlled vocabulary rejects. Found while calibrating tools/check_glossary.mjs against the four wave-1 maps (--applied). They are recorded here, not silently rewritten: the wave-1 maps are the audit trail of a signed release.
rule: A name may not end in digits, may not be under three characters, and may not be a banned disambiguator (data, context, temp, ...).
note: Seven names, all inside files the wave-2 burn-down will revisit anyway (stage/runtime/panel/purifier). Renaming them outside a batch would break the one-batch-one-rollback-point rule, so they are carried as open findings and fixed when their file comes up.
